name: Colorado
status_why: Clarity on CloudFront answered scripts; the kit already reads it.
system: Clarity Elections (Scytl/Civix ENR), results.enr.clarityelections.com/CO, on CloudFront.

results_page.label: Colorado Secretary of State: election results

feeds.address: https://results.enr.clarityelections.com/CO/<EID>/current_ver.txt, then /CO/<EID>/<ver>/reports/detailxml.zip (detail.xml: every contest, choice and county); election list at /CO/elections.json?v=1 (gzip JSON: EID, ElectionName, Date)
feeds.updates: new version number each upload (all-mail counting; counties report through the night and for days)
feeds.note: HTTP 200 on 2026-10-09: current_ver.txt for 126592 = 377440; elections.json lists 2026 Primary 126592, 2025 Coordinated 124409, 2024 General 122598, 2024 Primary 121727, 2022 General 115903. Nov 3, 2026 not listed yet.

feeds.address: https://results.enr.clarityelections.com/CO/<County>/<county EID>/<ver>/reports/detailxml.zip (each county's own Clarity page, with precinct detail and local races)
feeds.note: County pages are linked from the state page.

precinct_level: on the county Clarity pages (state page is county level)
local: Yes, on Clarity under /CO/<County>/: Denver, El Paso, Arapahoe, Jefferson, Adams, Larimer, Boulder.
how_counted: Colorado votes by mail. Counties add ballots in batches through the night and for days after.
count_order: One vote type ('Total Votes'); count order is the order of uploads, version by version.
vote_types: The state detail.xml has one VoteType ('Total Votes') per choice (ballot/lists/co.py stops if more appear). Colorado votes by mail, so the count-order signal is the order of uploads (version by version), not ballot type.

certify.rule: No later than the 27th day after the election (Colo. Rev. Stat. 1-10-103(2)).
certify.local_rule: Counties send their abstracts no later than the 22nd day (Colo. Rev. Stat. 1-10-103).
certify.source: NCSL, 'Election Certification Deadlines' (www.ncsl.org/elections-and-campaigns/certification-deadlines), read 2026-10-10; secondary: a summary of each state's law, not the law itself

rehearsal: EID 126592 (2026 primary): replay check 2026-10-10, 38 races equal the certified abstract; the one difference is a write-in candidate for Governor (Republican) named in the abstract, whom the feed counts only as write-ins; 122598 (2024 general)
terms: None seen in the API answers.
scout_plan: Rehearse on 122598. On election night poll current_ver.txt every couple of minutes and fetch detailxml.zip only when the version changes; that gives every statewide, Congress and legislative contest by county. Saving each version also feeds the count-order predictor (how each county's share moves upload by upload). Local results: the large counties' Clarity pages, same reader.
sources: NCSL, 'Election Certification Deadlines' (www.ncsl.org/elections-and-campaigns/certification-deadlines), read 2026-10-10; secondary: a summary of each state's law, not the law itself
